test_case.test_name: PCIe Gen5 AER validation pending NVDiag mode
test_case.purpose: Validate the approved Gen5 AER passive or bounded-injection scenario on the exact topology with expected OS/BMC handling and recovery.
required_package: Isolation, abort, SKU exception and OOB recovery
test_case.test_command: Do not run until semantics are approved. Capture baseline AER/SEL/topology; execute only the signed bounded scenario; correlate tool, kernel, BMC and link counters; verify recovery and final function.
test_case.expected_result: Each authorized AER scenario produces exactly the expected handling/counter deltas, no unapproved error, and SUT remains healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Tool PASS alone, an unknown SKU exception, or unapproved fault injection cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Dedicated isolated SUT and OOB access
test_case.recovery: Stop injection, execute vendor recovery/OOB path, verify link/GPU/OS health and preserve all error logs.
